row.name: Affiliated Managers Group Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=38 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.52 tightness=0.91 base_volume_vs_leg=0.86 base_volume_vs_avg=0.97
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 38 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 0.52 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 2.9% vs its 20-SMA, 0.7% over 20 sessions

claude.reason: Three recorded FAILs — C (38-session base with 0.52 giveback), RE (burst bar only 46% of the prior 5-bar range), and VOL (volume fell 40% versus the prior session and sits at rank 16 of 60, well below the catalyst-volume threshold required for a base over 21 sessions) — are all visible in the chart: the shaded consolidation box spans from early August through late September with wide, overlapping bars and no tightening, the signal bar is a modest candle dwarfed by earlier bars in the base, and volume on the signal day is clearly lighter than surrounding sessions. The base is also visually declining from the ~380 peak toward the 350s before recovering, confirming the 0.52 giveback measurement. With three hard FAILs and no A+ checks on the critical criteria, the mechanical A grade cannot be sustained on chart review.
claude.key_risk: A 38-session loose base with 52% giveback and sub-threshold volume means there is no compression to release, making a sustained burst unlikely.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the signal day's close of 370.61 or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below the prior session's pace.
